newsitem.title: USA: Banyan Mortgage gets unsolicited offer.
newsitem.headline: Banyan Mortgage gets unsolicited offer.

text.p: Banyan Mortgage Investment Fund said it received an unsolicited proposal from Apollo Real Estate Advisors II LP to acquire all of Banyan Mortgage's outstanding shares for $0.46875 a share.
Banyan Mortgage shares closed Tuesday at 3/8.
Apollo also proposed to fund retirement of certain of Banyan Mortgage's indebtedness.

Banyan Mortgage said its board has directed management and its financial advisors to enter discussions with Apollo to obtain additional information, which will enable directors to evaluate the proposal.
Copies of the proposal have been provided to Banyan Mortgage's board of directors, it added.
Banyan Mortgage said the proposal is subject to due diligence, completion of mutually satisfactory documentation and other conditions.
